name: The Blue Lighthouse
source:
During a road trip to your old seaside hometown, you decide to stop at a lighthouse right by the sea. Your break for fresh air and to clear your mind leads you to meet the lighthouse keeper. 

Sometimes the simplest encounters are the ones we don't forget.

[From [url=https://slowlytee.itch.io/the-blue-lighthouse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在自驾返回海滨老家小镇的公路旅行途中，你决定在海边的一座灯塔旁停下歇脚。原本只是想透透新鲜空气、放空一下思绪，却让你在那里邂逅了守塔人。

有时候，最简单纯粹的相遇，恰恰最令人终生难忘。

[摘自[url=https://slowlytee.itch.io/the-blue-lighthouse]itch.io[/url]]
